title: Application of New England Hydro-Transmission Electric Company, Inc., for authorization and approval of: (1) proposed borrowings from New England Hydro Finance Company, Inc. ("NEHFC") not to exceed $220,000,000 under G.L. c. 164, § 14, as amended; (2) a proposed guarantee not to exceed $220,000,000 under G.L. c. 164, § 17A, as amended; (3) an exemption from the requirements of G.L. c. 164, § 15, as amended; (4) the investment of its funds in the stock of a financing company under G.L. c. 164, § 17A, as amended; all in connection with the financing of the Hydro-Quebec interconnection with New England ("Phase II" or the "Project").
petitioner: New England Hydro-Transmission Electric Company, Inc.
